subject: SOC 2 recertification — evidence availability, retention ask, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@emeraldbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 recertification — initial asks and retention question

Hi Tessa,

We're kicking off Emerald Bank's annual recertification and I wanted to confirm two things before we schedule the intake call:

1) Evidence bundle — can Redwood provide an index of the artifacts you typically share for SOC 2 (control mappings, log retention buckets, agent lists, ingestion manifests)? We prefer a CSV or manifest so we can assign ownership here.

2) Retention horizon — Emerald is evaluating moving to a 24-month log retention for certain audit-related streams (auth, payments). Is that supported today and what operational impact / timing should we expect?

Also: there is a potential commercial change on our side — we are considering increasing committed seats from ~500 to ~1,200 if retention and regional residency can be addressed. If that’s possible, would Redwood support a contract amendment versus a new SOW?

I can be on a call early next week. Please let me know what you need from us to get started.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Director, Information Security
Emerald Bank
security@emeraldbank.com

Attachment: Emerald-SOC2-Kickoff-questions.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recertification — initial asks and retention question

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide an evidence index / manifest and we can support 24-month retention for the streams you listed, but it requires a retention config change and an amendment for the storage cost delta.

Proposed next steps:
- I’ve attached a lightweight evidence manifest we use internally (redwood-soc2-evidence-manifest.csv) — please use it to flag which artifacts you need and we’ll stage them to a secure transfer bucket.
- Karthik will scope the operational impact for 24-month retention and share the engineering checklist and timeline.
- Laura will scope commercial options for a seat uplift + retention amendment (term extension vs. one-time charge).

We can do a 30-minute intake call Tuesday 6/22 at 09:00 PT — does that work? If not, propose two slots.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-evidence-manifest.csv (csv stub), log-retention-matrix.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SOC 2 recertification — intake and commercial note

Hi Priya — looping in commercial details:

Thanks for the context. High level on pricing and contract:
- Seat uplift (500 -> 1,200): we can support this under an amendment to the existing order form. We would typically offer a stepped discount for a 12–24 month term extension tied to the uplift.
- Retention to 24 months: this is an additive operational/storage cost. For audit-grade immutability we suggest using our WORM-backed bucket option (adds ~6% on the storage portion).
- Recommendation: term extension + one-time retention setup fee + adjusted monthly storage. I’ll have a draft amendment ready within 3 business days if you want to proceed.

I’ve also attached a short handoff doc (handover-instructions.pdf) that explains how we stage evidence into a restricted bucket and how we provide access to auditors.

If helpful, Marcus Lin from our Customer Success Pricing team is on this thread and can run a quick delta estimate based on your current seat metrics.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick operational checklist from my side before the intake call on Tuesday:

1) Confirm which log streams need 24-month retention (please mark in the manifest): auth-events, payments-audit, api-proxy (we need explicit list).
2) Confirm regional residency requirement: if you require GovCloud-only for those streams we’ll need a scoped onboarding (estimated 6–8 week lead time).
3) We will pre-stage artifacts in a read-only bucket and provide a short-lived auditor token; please confirm list of auditor emails for access.
4) I’ll run a perf impact assessment for the longer retention window (ingest + query costs) — expect a delta estimate within 48 hours after we have the stream list.

Links: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/EMB-42; Drive manifest where we’ll stage artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/0Bexample
